visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up shot of a white cafe table where a glass of yellow fruit juice with a white straw and a small ceramic bowl sit. A woman's torso is visible across the table, she wears a dark brown knit top and a thin necklace with a light blue teddy bear pendant. (2) A sharp transition to a night scene on a grassy field at a music festival. A man wearing a green sequined shirt is on one knee before a woman in a matching green sequined bra top and fringe skirt, surrounded by the glow of stage lights and blurred festival-goers in the background. (3) The scene shifts to a montage of the man's hands in a workshop setting, where he is seen working with a black composite material. He is wearing a blue and white Everlast track jacket and a white face mask, using a UV curing light and a precision handheld grinder to shape a small ring. (4) A shot shows the man in an industrial environment operating a large metal lathe. The camera captures close-ups of the machining process where a ring suddenly cracks and breaks apart. The man then sits in a dimly lit office space, resting his head in his hands with a look of extreme frustration and exhaustion. (5) The narrative continues with the man airbrushing a finished black ring with vibrant green paint inside a spray booth. He then showcases a unique ring that features a glowing, color-shifting LED-like internal strip that cycles through rainbow colors in a pitch-black room. (6) The man stands in a brightly lit indoor office or hallway, speaking directly into the camera lens while holding the finished green ring between his fingers. He wears black-rimmed glasses and his blue track jacket, displaying a mixture of nervousness and pride. (7) Returning to the nighttime festival, the man and woman are sitting together on a grassy slope with their arms around each other. The glowing 'ULTRA' music festival logo is visible on a large wall behind them, along with many other young people sitting on the grass. (8) The man stands up and kneels again, officially proposing with the handmade ring. The woman reacts with shock and joy, covering her mouth with her hands. The surrounding crowd is seen cheering and holding up smartphones to record the intimate moment. (9) The couple shares a kiss as animated golden confetti and starburst effects are overlaid on the screen. The woman then holds her hand up to the camera, proudly displaying the oversized, uniquely crafted green ring on her finger while smiling broadly.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 過了三年這麼沒誠意. 你覺得還需要嫁嗎. (2) [Subtitle]: 你願意嫁給我嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 如果大家有看到這支影片. 代表我已經完成了一場. 人生的大事. (4) [Subtitle]: 過去一個多月. 我把所有的時間都花在. 這顆戒指上面. (5) [Subtitle]: 習慣遇到困難就選擇放棄的我. 一共經歷了八次的失敗. 怎麼會這樣. 快好了結果爆開了. 今天又做白工. (6) [Subtitle]: 無數次不想繼續做的念頭. 在我腦裡浮出. 是不是直接買一個鑽戒. 會來得輕鬆許多. (7) [Subtitle]: 這些全部都是做失敗的. 但是我心裡一直有一個想法. (8) [Subtitle]: 在我這樣不斷的失敗 沮喪. 從頭開始. 如果最後我真的成功了. 代表這顆鑽戒. 是充滿著意義的. (9) [Subtitle]: 最後一次機會. 成功了. 做了應該有十次吧. 終於成功一次了. (10) [Subtitle]: 我想要把這個禮物. 送給我最愛的人. 終於. 在出國的前兩天我完成了. (11) [Subtitle]: 今天是3/22禮拜六. 下禮拜五在美國就要求婚了. (12) [Subtitle]: 這是我的最後一次噴漆上色. 這次成功就完成了. (13) [Subtitle]: 雖然它長得很怪. 跟鑽戒長得完全不一樣. 但它仍然是我. 親手做出來. 世界上獨一無二的戒指. (14) [Subtitle]: 凱哥我今天要求婚了. 可以給我一點信心嗎. 我也沒什麼信心欸. (19) [Subtitle]: 在我加班回家沒有吃飯的時候. 煮飯給我吃我就覺得很感動. 只是一個餃子而已. 也可以讓我非常感動. (20) [Subtitle]: 然後我想要謝謝你. 帶我去你阿姨那邊. 謝謝你讓我在桃園有個家的感覺. (21) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這句話讓你等太久. 很對不起你. 我今天有準備一個戒指. (22) [Subtitle]: 我準備了一個. 我自己做了一個多月的戒指要給你. (23) [Subtitle]: 你願意嫁給我嗎. 可以. (24) [Subtitle]: 太鬆了吧. 謝謝你在茫茫人海中遇見你. [Logo]: @elephant_gogo

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male creator, 1 female partner, and a large crowd of festival attendees in the background of the proposal scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a blue Everlast track jacket during the crafting scenes and a green sequined shirt during the proposal. A young Asian woman with long dark hair, wearing a brown knit top initially and a green sparkly rave outfit for the festival proposal.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a brightly lit cafe, an industrial workshop containing a lathe and various metalworking tools, a modern office with computers, and an outdoor music festival at night featuring large illuminated structures and grassy lawns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence begins with a male voiceover in Mandarin over a gentle, sentimental piano melody. The tone is reflective and narrative. Faint background chatter and the sound of a liquid being poured into a glass provide ambient indoor texture. (2) A transition occurs where workshop noises are introduced: the high-pitched whine of a mechanical grinder and several percussive thuds as tools hit a surface. The narrator's voice becomes more somber as he describes the difficulty of his task. (3) The background music shifts to a more cinematic orchestral style with rising string arrangements. A loud, sharp 'crack' sound marks the ring breaking, followed by a heavy sigh and the muffled sounds of industrial machinery operating in a large room. (4) The audio changes to a direct-to-camera address. The voice has more natural room reverb. The sound of a passing bus engine and outdoor wind gusts are audible for a short period before cutting to the music festival environment. (5) The final phase features a transition to high-energy EDM pop with a prominent electronic beat and male English vocals. This is mixed with loud, high-arousal crowd noise including cheering, whistling, and synchronized clapping. (6) The woman's voice rises in pitch and volume, shouting excitedly in response to the proposal. The energetic pop track continues to play at a high volume, blending with the sounds of laughter and the celebratory reactions of the surrounding crowd.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal storytelling vlog that documents a creator's arduous one-month journey of hand-making a unique, LED-lit engagement ring. It contrasts his repeated failures in the workshop with the ultimate emotional payoff of a successful marriage proposal at the Ultra Music Festival in Miami, aiming to share a deeply personal milestone and the effort behind a significant romantic gesture.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully uses a 'making-of' narrative to build suspense and emotional investment before the final proposal scene.
